title: Blow-up Parameter Landscapes for Polynomial Dynamical Systems
summary: Finite-time blow-up is one of the ways in which a dynamical model can become singular, often signaling the breakdown of either the modeled physical system or the model itself. Determining whether blow-up occurs, and for which parameter values and initial conditions, is therefore a fundamental problem in the analysis of nonlinear dynamical systems.
